method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed original giant_magellan_southern_support_buildingOriginal2023 site-context frame with explicitly approximate component registration. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.

Composite source relief can contain water-level, canopy and DEM void artifacts; it is not bathymetry or an exposed foundation survey. Source field does not certify historic ground contact.
